command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RS'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[[1]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (ncol(d) != 7L) stop("Expected geneID plus six count columns")
gene_id <- d[[1]]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_id)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers")
mat <- as.matrix(d[, 2:7, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(mat) <- "integer"
rownames(mat) <- gene_id
condition <- factor(c("KL", "KL", "KL", "WL", "WL", "WL"), levels = c("WL", "KL"))
coldata <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(mat))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = mat, colData = coldata, design = ~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res0 <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "KL", "WL"), alpha = 0.05)
res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_KL_vs_WL", res = res0, type = "normal")
out <- data.frame(geneID = rownames(res), as.data.frame(res), check.names = FALSE)
write.table(out, file = "deseq2_shrunken.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
keep <- !is.na(out[["pvalue"]]) & out[["pvalue"]] < 0.05 &
        !is.na(out[["log2FoldChange"]]) & abs(out[["log2FoldChange"]]) > 1 &
        !is.na(out[["baseMean"]]) & out[["baseMean"]] > 10
writeLines(out[["geneID"]][keep], con = "significant_ensembl.txt")
RS
